chunks.title: Chatbot Knowledge Rules
chunks.text:
This document contains stable Tinitiate AI Solutions information.

For live or frequently changing information such as:

* Current courses
* Course-specific pricing
* Upcoming batches
* Trainers
* Workshop dates
* Demo slots
* Meeting links
* Availability

the chatbot must use live website/database data instead of relying on this document.

For policy-specific questions, the dedicated policy section is authoritative.

For refund questions, use the Refund \& Cancellation Policy as the primary source.

For privacy questions, use the Privacy Policy as the primary source.

For cookie questions, use the Cookie Policy as the primary source.

For general legal terms, use the Terms \& Conditions.

chunks.title: About Tinitiate AI Solutions
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions focuses on practical IT and AI training built around real-world skills, projects, mentorship, and career readiness.

The training philosophy is to make AI and technology careers accessible through practical learning rather than theory alone.

Tinitiate AI Solutions was created by practitioners who identified a gap between how technology is commonly taught and how it is actually built and used in industry.

Programs are designed around skills that are relevant to real-world technical roles.

Core learning principles include:

* Learning by building
* Portfolio-ready projects
* Practical exercises
* Industry-oriented skills
* Mentor guidance
* Trainers with practical industry experience
* Career readiness
* Real-world project experience

The focus is on practical outcomes rather than simply completing training hours.

chunks.title: Training Approach
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions follows a hands-on, project-oriented approach.

Students may learn through:

* Instructor-led sessions
* Practical exercises
* Labs
* Guided projects
* Real-world projects
* Mentor support
* Assignments
* Capstone projects
* Interview preparation
* Career guidance

Course-specific curriculum, duration, trainer, price, and upcoming batch information must be retrieved from the live database.

chunks.title: Classroom Training
chunks.text:
Classroom Training is intended for students who prefer learning in person.

Sessions are conducted in small groups with direct access to the trainer.

Students receive:

* In-person trainer interaction
* Hands-on practice
* Immediate feedback
* Practical learning support

The classroom location and current classroom batches must be retrieved from live website/database information.

Users interested in classroom training can book a free demo.

chunks.title: Online Training
chunks.text:
Online Training provides live, instructor-led training that students can attend remotely.

Online learners receive the same core curriculum, project-based learning, and mentor access as classroom learners.

Online Training is suitable for students who cannot regularly attend a physical classroom.

Current online batches and schedules must be retrieved from the live database.

Users interested in Online Training can book a free demo.

chunks.title: Weekend Training
chunks.text:
Weekend Training is designed for learners who need to keep weekdays available.

Weekend batches are particularly suitable for:

* Working professionals
* Students with weekday commitments
* Learners requiring a more flexible schedule

Weekend batches generally meet on Saturdays and Sundays while covering the applicable course curriculum.

Current weekend schedules and batch availability must be retrieved from the live database.

chunks.title: Internships
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions provides project-based internship opportunities.

Internships focus on applying learned skills to practical projects with guidance from mentors and the engineering team.

Internship learning may include:

* Real-world projects
* Production-style assignments
* Practical implementation
* Mentor guidance
* Proof of Concepts (PoCs)
* Capstone projects
* Industry-oriented working practices

Internships may run alongside core training programs.

Current internship batches and availability must be retrieved from the live database.

chunks.title: Real-Time Projects
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions provides Real-Time Projects to help learners gain practical experience.

These projects are designed to simulate real software development and deployment environments.

They help students apply technical knowledge through production-style project work.

The available Real-Time Projects, their names, descriptions, levels, and availability must always be retrieved from the live database because they can change.

chunks.title: Job Assistance
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions provides career support that continues beyond course completion.

Job Assistance may include:

chunks.title: Job Assistance > Skill Assessments
chunks.text: Structured assessments help learners understand how their skills compare with expectations from hiring teams.

chunks.title: Job Assistance > Hiring Partner Network
chunks.text: Qualified graduate profiles may be shared with hiring partners, and referral opportunities may be organized where available.

chunks.title: Job Assistance > Career Counseling
chunks.text:
Career support may include:

* Resume building
* ATS-friendly resume preparation
* LinkedIn profile optimization
* GitHub portfolio development
* Interview preparation
* Technical mock interviews
* HR interview preparation
* Career guidance
* Salary negotiation guidance

chunks.title: Job Assistance > Job Market Insights
chunks.text: Learners may receive guidance about hiring trends and skills that are currently relevant to the job market.

chunks.title: Job Assistance > Important Placement Disclaimer
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions provides placement assistance and career support, but employment is not guaranteed.

Final hiring decisions are made by recruiting organizations.

Outcomes depend on factors including:

* Student skills
* Student performance
* Interview performance
* Individual effort
* Market conditions
* Employer requirements

chunks.title: Placement Assistance
chunks.text:
Eligible students may receive:

* Resume preparation
* Resume review
* Mock interviews
* Interview opportunities
* Career guidance
* Placement assistance
* Employer referrals
* Industry referrals

Placement assistance does not represent a guarantee of employment, salary, interview selection, internship selection, or job offer.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy
chunks.text:

By using our website or services, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

Our services are intended for students, graduates, and working professionals.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy
chunks.text:
At Tinitiate AI Solutions, we strive to provide high-quality training, internship opportunities, and career guidance. This Refund \& Cancellation Policy explains the terms governing course cancellations, refunds, transfers, and related matters.

By enrolling in any of our programs, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to this policy.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 1\. Course Registration
chunks.text:
Your enrollment is confirmed only after:

* Successful submission of the registration form
* Payment of the applicable course fee
* Confirmation from Tinitiate AI Solutions

Seats are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 2\. Cancellation by Student
chunks.text:
Students wishing to withdraw from a program must submit a written cancellation request to:

Email: contact@tinitiateai.com

Refund eligibility will be determined based on the date the written request is received.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 3\. Refund Eligibility > Before Course Commencement
chunks.text: Students who cancel at least 7 days before the scheduled course start date are eligible for a 100% refund, excluding any payment gateway, transaction, or administrative charges.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 3\. Refund Eligibility > Within 7 Days Before Course Start
chunks.text: Students cancelling less than 7 days before the course begins may receive a refund after deducting an administrative fee of 10% of the course fee or Rs.2,000, whichever is higher.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 3\. Refund Eligibility > After Course Commencement
chunks.text:
Once the training program has started and course materials, recordings, or learning platform access have been provided, course fees are generally non-refundable.

Requests for exceptional circumstances, such as medical emergencies, may be reviewed on a case-by-case basis at the sole discretion of Tinitiate AI Solutions.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 4\. Internship Programs
chunks.text:
Internship fees, if applicable, become non-refundable once the internship has commenced, project work has been assigned, or company resources have been allocated.

Students are expected to complete the internship according to the published schedule.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 5\. Batch Transfers
chunks.text:
Students may request to transfer to a future batch, subject to:

* Seat availability
* Approval by Tinitiate AI Solutions
* The request being made before substantial completion of the current program

Additional administrative charges may apply.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 6\. Course Cancellation by Tinitiate AI Solutions
headings: 6\. Course Cancellation by Tinitiate AI Solutions
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions reserves the right to postpone, reschedule, or cancel any program due to:

* Insufficient enrollments
* Faculty availability
* Technical issues
* Natural disasters
* Government restrictions
* Other unforeseen circumstances

In such cases, students may choose one of the following:

* Transfer to the next available batch
* Enroll in an equivalent program
* Receive a full refund of the amount paid

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 7\. Payment Gateway Charges
chunks.text: Any payment gateway fees, bank charges, foreign exchange charges, or transaction processing fees incurred during payment or refund processing may be deducted from the refundable amount where applicable.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 8\. Refund Processing
chunks.text:
Approved refunds will normally be processed within 7-10 business days.

Refunds will be made to the original payment method whenever possible.

Processing time may vary depending on the payment provider or financial institution.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 9\. No Refund Situations
chunks.text:
Refunds will generally not be provided in the following situations:

* Failure to attend classes
* Voluntary withdrawal after substantial course participation
* Violation of institute policies
* Academic misconduct
* Removal from the program due to disciplinary action
* Failure to meet internship or project requirements

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 10\. Digital Learning Materials
chunks.text:
All digital resources, including:

* Recorded sessions
* Course notes
* Presentations
* Source code
* Templates
* Assignments
* Practice datasets

are non-refundable once access has been granted.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 11\. Placement Assistance
chunks.text:
Placement assistance is provided as an additional career support service.

Fees paid for training programs are not refundable solely because a student does not receive an interview, internship, or job offer.

Employment decisions are made exclusively by recruiting organizations.

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 12\. Force Majeure
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions shall not be held responsible for delays or inability to conduct programs due to events beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to:

* Natural disasters
* Government actions
* Internet outages
* Power failures
* Public health emergencies
* Civil disturbances

chunks.title: Refund \& Cancellation Policy > 13\. Changes to This Policy
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions reserves the right to update or modify this Refund \& Cancellation Policy at any time.

The latest version will always be available on our website.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy
chunks.text:
Welcome to Tinitiate AI Solutions.

This Cookie Policy explains how we use cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website or use our online services.

By continuing to browse or use our website, you consent to our use of cookies in accordance with this Cookie Policy.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 1\. What Are Cookies?
chunks.text:
Cookies are small text files that are stored on your computer, tablet, or mobile device when you visit a website.

They help websites:

* Remember your preferences
* Improve website performance
* Enhance user experience
* Analyze visitor behavior
* Provide secure access to services

Cookies do not normally contain information that directly identifies you, but they may be linked to information you have provided to us.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 2\. Why We Use Cookies
chunks.text:
Tinitiate AI Solutions uses cookies to:

* Improve website performance
* Remember your preferences
* Keep you signed in where applicable
* Analyze website traffic
* Measure training program interest
* Improve our courses and services
* Provide a better browsing experience

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 3\. Types of Cookies We Use > Essential Cookies
chunks.text:
These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly.

Examples include:

* User authentication
* Session management
* Security features
* Form submissions

Without these cookies, certain parts of the website may not function correctly.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 3\. Types of Cookies We Use > Performance \& Analytics Cookies
chunks.text:
These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website.

They allow us to measure:

* Number of visitors
* Most visited pages
* Time spent on pages
* Navigation paths
* Website performance

This information helps us improve our website and user experience.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 3\. Types of Cookies We Use > Functional Cookies
chunks.text:
These cookies remember your preferences, such as:

* Language selection
* Login preferences
* Previously viewed pages
* Course preferences

These cookies provide a more personalized browsing experience.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 3\. Types of Cookies We Use > Marketing Cookies
chunks.text:
With your consent, marketing cookies may be used to:

* Measure advertising performance
* Display relevant course advertisements
* Promote upcoming training programs
* Analyze campaign effectiveness

These cookies may be provided by trusted third-party advertising platforms.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 4\. Third-Party Cookies
chunks.text:
Our website may use trusted third-party services that set cookies, including:

* Google Analytics
* Google Tag Manager
* YouTube embedded videos
* LinkedIn
* Meta (Facebook)
* Payment Gateway Providers

These third parties have their own privacy and cookie policies.

We encourage you to review their respective policies for additional information.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 5\. Managing Cookies
chunks.text:
Most web browsers automatically accept cookies.

You may choose to:

* Accept all cookies
* Reject non-essential cookies
* Delete stored cookies
* Receive notifications before cookies are stored

These settings can usually be changed through your browser preferences.

Please note that disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 6\. Browser Settings
chunks.text:
You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

Common browser help pages include:

* Google Chrome
* Microsoft Edge
* Mozilla Firefox
* Apple Safari

Refer to your browser's support documentation for instructions on managing cookies.

chunks.title: Cookie Policy > 7\. Changes to This Cookie Policy
chunks.text:
We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in:

* Technology
* Legal requirements
* Website functionality
* Business operations

The latest version will always be available on this page.

chunks.text:

chunks.text:
Yes. Tinitiate AI Solutions is designed to help learners from non-STEM and non-computer-science backgrounds build practical technology skills.

Students do not need to come from a Computer Science background to begin learning technology.

With the right foundation, guided practice, hands-on projects, and mentorship, students from different educational backgrounds can develop skills for areas such as software, data, cloud, automation, and related technology roles.
